verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a project or space feature that groups related chats and files under shared context and instructions. The Library is described only as a curation of discoveries. Labs is about producing reports and projects, not organizing chats with shared instructions. API profiles are a developer configuration primitive, not this end-user capability.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
